title: Everything Mosque Administrators Need
subtitle: 12 modules designed to cover every aspect of mosque management — from finances to congregation, all in one place.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.desc: An at-a-glance overview of your mosque's key metrics and recent activity.
details: Real-time financial summary: income, expenses, and balances.
Congregation growth trends and attendance charts.
Upcoming events and pending task reminders.
Quick-access cards for ZISWAF, reports, and broadcast status.

congregation.title: Congregation Management
congregation.desc: Complete congregation data with family relationships, roles, and skills.
details: Store full congregation profiles: name, address, phone, family members.
Assign roles such as imam, muezzin, marbot, treasurer, or secretary.
Record skills and expertise for better community coordination.
Search, filter, and sort congregation data instantly.

finance.title: Finance
finance.desc: Cash recording, budgets, and transparent financial tracking for your mosque.
details: Record income and expenses with categories and proof of transaction.
Set monthly or annual budgets and track actual vs. planned spending.
Approval workflow for expenditures to ensure accountability.
Automatic cash flow reports ready for DKM meetings.

ziswaf.title: ZISWAF & Zakat
ziswaf.desc: Manage zakat, infaq, sadaqah, and waqf — compliant with PSAK 109.
details: Record all types of ZISWAF collections with donor details.
PSAK 109-compliant reports ready for audit and transparency.
Track zakat distribution to mustahik with full documentation.
Automatic categorization of zakat, infaq, sadaqah, and waqf funds.

zakatFitrah.title: Zakat Fitrah
zakatFitrah.desc: Organize zakat fitrah collection and distribution during Ramadan.
details: Record muzakki names and the amount of zakat fitrah collected.
Track distribution to mustahik with receipt confirmation.
Automatic summary of total collected vs. total distributed.
Print collection and distribution reports for transparency.

events.title: Events & Activities
events.desc: 15 activity types with automatic recurring, registration, and attendance.
details: Create events from 15 built-in types: study circles, lectures, communal prayers, and more.
Set up automatic recurring events — daily, weekly, or monthly.
Open registration and track attendance for each event.
Broadcast event reminders to congregation via WhatsApp.

broadcast.title: Broadcast Messages
broadcast.desc: Send announcements, bills, and reminders to congregation via WhatsApp.
details: Send broadcast messages to all or selected congregation groups.
Automatic payment reminders and contribution notices.
Schedule messages for the right time — no manual sending needed.
Message templates for common announcements and invitations.

reports.title: PDF Reports
reports.desc: Generate monthly cash reports, ZIS PSAK 109, and qurban reports in PDF.
details: One-click monthly cash report generation in PDF format.
PSAK 109-compliant ZISWAF reports ready for audit.
Qurban distribution reports with donor and recipient details.
Export congregation data and event attendance summaries.

qurban.title: Qurban
qurban.desc: Manage qurban collections, animal procurement, and distribution logistics.
details: Record qurban contributions from congregation members.
Track animal procurement: type, weight, cost, and supplier.
Coordinate distribution to recipients with full documentation.
Print qurban reports showing contributions, costs, and distribution.

inventory.title: Inventory
inventory.desc: Track mosque assets, supplies, and maintenance needs.
details: Catalog all mosque assets: equipment, furniture, electronics.
Track maintenance schedules and repair history.
Monitor supplies and consumables with low-stock alerts.
Record asset values for transparent financial reporting.

tpq.title: TPQ/Tahfidz
tpq.desc: Manage Quran education programs, students, teachers, and progress.
details: Enroll students and assign them to classes and teachers.
Track each student's memorization progress and juz completion.
Schedule classes and manage teacher availability.
Generate progress reports for parents and program evaluation.

prayerSchedule.title: Prayer Schedule
prayerSchedule.desc: Display daily prayer times and manage imam/muezzin schedules.
details: Automatic daily prayer times based on your mosque's location.
Assign imam and muezzin for each prayer time on a weekly or monthly basis.
Display schedules in the mosque dashboard for easy reference.
Notify assigned persons automatically before their scheduled time.

ctaSection.title: All features, free.
ctaSection.subtitle: No hidden fees. No premium tiers. Every mosque deserves proper management tools.
